notablePrerequisites: Butcher Ghoul does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability and Sengir's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Butcher Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Butcher Ghoul.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Butcher Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
